headline: Names a Postal Service building in Springboro, Ohio, after Richard "Dick" Chenault.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 55 South Pioneer Boulevard in Springboro, Ohio, as the "Richard 'Dick' Chenault Post Office Building." It is an honorary name change only. The summary does not describe any other changes to the building, its services, or its operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015.
